type IteratorKey = typeof Symbol.iterator;
type UnscopablesKey = typeof Symbol.unscopables;
type Extracted = Extract<keyof number[], symbol>;
const ordinary: Extracted = '__@iterator';
const local = Symbol('local');
const wrongIdentity: IteratorKey = local;
const wrongProtocol: IteratorKey = undefined as unknown as UnscopablesKey;
const invalidFlags: number[][UnscopablesKey] = { entries: 4 };
